pixelParityRenderingDifferences.difference: The Figma decorative export is a flattened complete screen, so it cannot be a runtime background. The implementation now uses a native cream/lamp/curve fallback with the shared transparent logo and live native loader; exact foliage remains unavailable. See asset-investigation.json.

pixelParityRenderingDifferences.screen: UI / Entry / Language Selection / FR + AR / Default
pixelParityRenderingDifferences.difference: Compared directly against SRC / 01-language-selection-french-arabic.png on 130 — Complete Source Archive. The exact Arabic marker and bottom-right decorative asset are not isolated; the production frame uses editable closest layers and the official logo.

The native screen is editable and uses the approved isolated Luna product artwork. The exact gallery chair photograph is only available inside the flattened source-screen image, which cannot be used as a runtime screen background under the Phase 5B rules.

The confirmation is native and editable, including the dimmed native storefront backdrop. Its exact sofa product photograph is only present inside the flattened source-screen image; no isolated approved source for that exact image is available.
The Cart is native and cart-backed. The exact reference products are only available inside the flattened screen reference; the approved isolated product artwork is used instead.

Figma source was captured at 393×852. The live Expo screen was reached through the cart flow, but the available browser host is fixed at 1280×720 and exposes no viewport control, so an honest 393×852 overlay is blocked. At the host size, the fixture's three vendor groups/three product lines differ from the persisted live cart. See the Phase 5B result.json.

assetInvestigation.finding: All eight inspected Figma product/order references resolve to flattened screen exports or contain non-isolated visual artwork. No replacement artwork was generated or adopted.
